messages.subject: Seb | Natural Resources & Commodities Executive Profile | Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stoove,

I am sharing my profile for senior international mandates across natural resources, mining, commodities and related industrial businesses.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your work across global agriculture and commodities, energy, natural resources and industrial leadership makes my background relevant to searches where commercial growth must be balanced with government interface, sustainability, reputation and social licence.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my global executive CV for confidential consideration.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
